I finished primary school so I can read the bags, but I still farm the way my father taught me unless I see a change work on my own plot. Last season I used two bags of NPK 20-10-10 on this 1.36 hectare sorghum plot and the harvest was better, so I will do the same this year — that is fifteen kilos of nitrogen per hectare — and I will add manure from my cattle because this land is mine. I will plant my own saved seed, I will not buy chemicals or irrigate, and my family will work seventy-five days on this plot from clearing to threshing. When the weeding is heavy I will hire young men from the village for ten days because at fifty-five I cannot manage all 1.36 hectares alone.
